scenarios.scenario: Path traversal via ?categories=../../x (cache paths are built from category ids)
scenarios.rationale: Ids are allow-listed against seed ids before any path is built; test_bad_params_422 and test_unknown_category_rejected_before_any_path_is_built.

scenarios.scenario: Endpoint triggers live provider calls or cache writes (cost, rate limits, data mutation)
scenarios.rationale: history.py only calls cache readers; test_read_only_no_cache_writes and the no_network fixture (all fetchers raise) prove it.
trigger.py and screener_board.py have an empty git diff; the RFC-1 contract test stays 3/3; get_categories source contains no history reference.

scenarios.scenario: Huge start/end range or malformed dates cause 500s
scenarios.rationale: FastAPI date parsing gives 422 on malformed input; ranges only filter the local archive, which is bounded by stored days.

scenarios.scenario: Non-redistributable data served without a flag
scenarios.rationale: Every series carries redistributable (all currently False) plus top-level redistributable_all.
